Answer: B
Reason: The radiograph shows lucent streaks of air extending from the mediastinum up into the soft tissues of the neck (cervical region), indicating pneumomediastinum with subcutaneous emphysema. The lung parenchyma demonstrates a reticular pattern that is predominantly peripheral and basilar (middle and lower zones), which is characteristic of usual interstitial pneumonia (UIP) associated with ILD.
